title: Rewinding the Work-Tape Head
statement: For every binary input $y$, binary word $u$, valid input-head position $p$ for $y$, and natural number $j\le |u|$, starting from the comparator configuration in rewind state with comparison flag true, work word $u$, work head at position $j-1$, and input-head position $p$, after $j+1$ steps it is in comparison state with flag true, the same input-head position and work word, and work head at position zero.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a valid input-head position for $y$
replaced: For every input, every decoded word $u$, every position and every $j \le |u|$: from the rewind state with work head at cell $j - 1$, exactly $j+1$ steps of the pair comparator reach the comparison state with work head at cell zero and all data unchanged.
